name: Sunshine Cake
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Beat whites of eggs until stiff and dry, add sugar gradually, and continue beating; then add yolks of eggs beaten until thick and lemon-colored, and extract.
Cut and fold in flour mixed and sifted with cream of tartar.
Bake fifty minutes in a moderate oven in an angel-cake pan.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
